fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole 1986 Hunter 23 sailboat with trailer.
findings: Dark blue hull side near the bow looks dull and flat rather than glossy, with some light hazing visible in the sun
Light dirt and grime streaks on the white foredeck and cabin top non-skid
Faded, weathered teak trim around the companionway hatch boards
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Hunter 23. The dark blue hull looks a bit dull in the photos and the deck could use a cleaning, and a gelcoat polish and wash would help it show much better to buyers. We do pre-sale boat details and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
